headlines.title: Go Brewing Names Performance Chef and Ultra-Endurance Athlete Dan Churchill Partner and Head of Strategy
headlines.summary: NAPERVILLE, Ill., September 01, 2026--Go Brewing, the Chicagoland-based non-alcoholic brewery recognized as the fastest-growing in the United States, today announced a landmark partnership with Dan Churchill — performance chef, ultra-endurance athlete, Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree, and one of the most recognized voices at the intersection of food, fitness, and human performance. Churchill joins Go Brewing as a partner and, in a newly created role, as Head of Strategy, effective immediately.

headlines.title: Strategy resumes bitcoin buying after 10-week pause, spends $370M
headlines.summary: The company bought 4,603 bitcoin at an average price of $80,318, funded by proceeds from selling newly issued common stock

headlines.title: Saylor Urges MSCI to Drop 'Discriminatory' Rule That Would Delete Strategy
headlines.summary: The proposed screen would cut three companies from MSCI's global indexes in November, with Strategy the largest by some distance.

headlines.title: Michael Saylor’s Strategy Calls MSCI’s New Delisting Test ‘Fundamentally Flawed,’ Says It’s Damaging ‘Its Reputation’
headlines.summary: Strategy asked MSCI to withdraw the proposal or apply changes only prospectively going forward.

headlines.title: Strategy Restarts Bitcoin Buying With 4,603 BTC Acquisition
headlines.summary: Bitcoin traded at $78,500 as the Japanese yen breached 160 per dollar in Tokyo trading, while a U.S. strike on Iran’s Larak Island added to bearish price prediction.

description: Strategy Inc, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a bitcoin treasury company in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It offers investors varying degrees of economic exposure to Bitcoin by offering a range of securities, including equity and fixed income instruments. The company also provides AI-powered enterprise analytics software, including Strategy One, which provides non-technical users with the ability to directly access novel and actionable insights for decision-making. In addition, the company provides Strategy Mosaic, a universal intelligence layer that offers enterprises with consistent definitions and governance across data sources, regardless of where that data resides or which tools access it. The company was formerly known as MicroStrategy Incorporated and changed its name to Strategy Inc in August 2025. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia.
